      Product description

      A good primer is the foundation of any great paint job, whether you are working on walls, wood, metal, or other surfaces. Primer is applied before the topcoat of paint to ensure better adhesion, improved durability, and a more uniform finish. It seals porous surfaces, hides stains and imperfections, and helps the final colour appear true and vibrant. Using a primer can significantly reduce the number of topcoat layers needed, saving both time and effort. Available in water-based and oil-based formulations, primers can be chosen based on the surface type and the paint being used. Ideal for both interior and exterior applications, a quality primer prepares your surface thoroughly for a long-lasting, professional-looking result. Whether you are repainting a room, refinishing furniture, or tackling a large construction project, starting with the right primer makes all the difference. Apply evenly using a brush, roller, or spray for best results.
